baseline: Current BLACKED V2 dark plum / pink / gold design; do not re-theme from scratch.

typography.smallLabels: 10px only for decorative/eyebrow text; never use for essential instructions

controls.touchTarget: At least 44x44 CSS px for important mobile actions
controls.focus: 3px visible pink focus outline with 2px offset
controls.reducedMotion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; do not require animation to understand a result
controls.keyboard: Every control keyboard-operable; Escape closes dialogs; return focus to invoker
controls.errors: Tell user what failed and how to recover; never silently discard a result

responsive.images: width:100%; height:auto; object-fit:cover for thumbnails; include explicit intrinsic width/height to reduce layout shift
